sloka: तस्य त्वनन्तरं जातः कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः ।प्रमाणाद्यस्य विपुलं प्रमाणं नेह विद्यते ।। ७.९.३३ ॥
transliteration: tasya tvanantaraṁ jātaḥ kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ ।pramāṇādyasya vipulaṁ pramāṇaṁ neha vidyate ।। 7.9.33 ॥

translations.english: After him, the immensely powerful Kumbhakarna was born, whose vast size and measure had no equal in this world.
